name: SPECTER
desc:
Investigate ghosts in haunted locations with your friends. Use your equipment to find paranormal evidence and work out the ghost type, then escape before the ghost hunts you!

Use hiding spots to your advantage, and carefully control your stamina to survive the hunt. If you need more help, read the journal's FAQ section during a match, or check out our server.

⚠️ This game contains flashing lights, loud noises, and scary scenes.
⚙️ An extensive settings menu is available in the lobby! Customize your experience to your liking.
🎧 We recommend using headphones for the best experience.
🎙️ Spirit box and the team radio feature support voice chat!
🎵 The lobby music and ambient soundtracks used in SPECTER are original and copyright free, you are free to use them in videos!

Inspired by the horror game Phasmophobia.
